articles.title: South African lawmakers propose draft rules on cross-border crypto transactions
articles.snippet: A draft rulebook proposes that sending crypto offshore must be conducted through an authorized provider and be reported to the central bank’s FinSurv.

articles.title: BlackRock debuts tokenized access to $311 billion of money market funds in Europe
articles.snippet: Earlier this week, BlackRock expanded its U.S. tokenized cash platform which involved offering onchain shares of an existing fund, plus a new daily reinvestment stablecoin fund.

articles.title: Bitcoin nears $64,000 as traders look past Strategy's BTC sales and Coldcard sweeps
articles.snippet: Every major token except ether is green on the week, with BTC up 1.9% over 24 hours and Asian equities selling off on AI-trade jitters.

articles.title: BNY to offer institutional crypto staking through Galaxy partnership
articles.snippet: The custody giant is expanding beyond safekeeping by adding staking services, allowing eligible institutional clients to earn yield on proof-of-stake assets.

articles.title: Bitcoin coils at $64K as Hormuz reopening timeline sends S&P 500 to $70T record
articles.snippet: Bitcoin built on $64,000 as hopes of the Strait of Hormuz reopening to oil traffic sent the S&P 500 index to a record $70 trillion market cap.
